Joins `egradx-audit` to `egradx-auth`, imported as `egradx.audit_auth`, as the Java `egradx-audit-auth` joins the Java libraries.

| Export | What it is |
|---|---|
| `audit_with_auth(auth)` | Adds the audit authorities (`egradx.audit.read`, `egradx.audit.platform.read`) to auth's catalog. Returns the `actors` and `names` options for `EgradxAuditor`. Call it before `auth.start()`. |
| `AuthAuditActors` | Who is calling the audit endpoints, and with which scope, from the signed-in caller. |
| `AuthAuditNames(auth)` | The names of the people and organizations in a record. |
| `audit_authority_contributor` | The authorities alone. |

```python
auditor = EgradxAuditor(engine, **audit_with_auth(auth))
```

Tested with `egradx-notification-auth`, in one application with all three libraries.

Import from `egradx.audit_auth`.

## Functions

### `audit_with_auth`

```python
def audit_with_auth(auth: EgradxAuth) -> dict[str, Any]
```

Contributes the audit authorities (call before `auth.start()`) and returns the auditor options that say who
acted and name the people on records: `EgradxAuditor(engine, **audit_with_auth(auth))`.
